method.action: Unauthenticated HTTP GET with redirects and full response consumption against every unique HTTPS source URL projected by all 123 record dossiers; retry once with a 60-second timeout only when the initial request is unresolved.

limitations: Reachability is not product observation, independent verification, or proof that rolling source prose is unchanged.
HTTP errors can reflect publisher anti-automation controls, rate limits, authentication boundaries or transient transport rather than source removal.
URL fragments are retained as distinct projected locators even though HTTP transport does not send fragments to the server.
